<fidel-voice-note>

Voice note. Record a short voice message, play it back, then send it; no speech-to-text.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners who speak more easily than they write, and blind learners. The recording is never turned into text by a cloud service.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። This example has no upload-url, so nothing is uploaded.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-voice-note label="Leave a voice message for your mentor" upload-url="/your/api/voice"></fidel-voice-note>

Source: player/src/components/e/voice-note.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-voice-note>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
labeltextnoneThe heading of the box.
max-secondsseconds120Longest recording.
upload-urlURLnoneWhere Send POSTs the recording (multipart field audio). Without it, the page gets an event.
no-sendbooleanoffHides Send (a parent such as <fidel-question> sends it).
heading-level2 to 53Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-voice-note>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-voice-note-ready{ blob, mimeType, durationSeconds }Without upload-url: the recording for the page.
fidel-voice-note-recorded{ mimeType, durationSeconds, size }A recording was made.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • The microphone is asked for only after "Start recording". A "Recording" banner with the time and Stop; then play back, Record again, and the size before Send.
  • No microphone or permission refused: the reason in words and a file picker for the phone's own recorder.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions: Says that nothing is recorded or sent until the learner chooses.
  • 2.4.3 Focus Order: Focus moves to each step's heading.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
